claims.text: The execution logs for containers container_1445144423722_0020_01_000006 and container_1445144423722_0020_01_000007 show similar patterns of assignment and launch, with both containers being assigned to their respective task attempts at the same time, 2015-10-18 18:03:55,408.

The containers are then launched remotely, with container_1445144423722_0020_01_000006 being launched at 2015-10-18 18:03:55,517 and container_1445144423722_0020_01_000007 being launched at 2015-10-18 18:03:55,595.
Both containers are using the same NodeManager, MSRA-SA-41.fareast.corp.microsoft.com:7109, as indicated by the last line of each group.

However, neither group shows any explicit signs of task failure, but the fact that these two containers are launched in quick succession for different task attempts, attempt_1445144423722_0020_m_000004_0 and attempt_1445144423722_0020_m_000005_0, respectively, and there is no indication of completion or success of the previous task attempt before the launch of the next one, suggests that these errors recur without a corrective action in between.
